description: Figure 2 is a line plot titled “Training Loss of 20M Data Size” that illustrates how training loss changes over training steps for six model configurations (ChemBART, ChemBERTa, and ChemLLaMA, each in Small and Medium sizes) on a 20M dataset. The x-axis is labeled “Step,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0K to 80K with regularly spaced tick labels at 0K, 20K, 40K, 60K, and 80K; there is also a small inset axis at the right showing a later-step region labeled from 420K to 440K with ticks at 420K, 430K, and 440K. The y-axis is labeled “Train Loss,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0.0 up to 0.85, with labeled ticks including 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.75, and 0.85. All six series are drawn as thin solid lines without visible point markers: ChemBART Small 20M is red, ChemBART Medium 20M is blue, ChemBERTa Small 20M is green, ChemBERTa Medium 20M is orange, ChemLLaMA Small 20M is purple, and ChemLLaMA Medium 20M is brown. Each line starts near the top of the plot around the first few steps (approximately in the 0.7–0.85 loss region), then drops steeply early on and continues decreasing more gradually through 80K steps, reaching values clustered near the lower part of the axis (roughly around 0.1–0.2 by 80K); in the inset (420K–440K), the same colored lines appear nearly flat and close together at low loss values, showing only small variations across that later-step interval.
